_README: Manual lat/lng for properties no geocoder can resolve - typically new
developments whose streets are not in the US Census TIGER database or
OpenStreetMap yet. Checked BEFORE any geocoding, so an entry here always wins.
To add one: open Google Maps, right-click the property, click the lat/lng at
the top of the menu (it copies), and paste it below as [latitude, longitude].
Key is the property Name exactly as it appears in AppFolio.
